tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ril nag 'bring po dang chung ngu'i zin bris 'chi ba gshol 'debs bzhugs so//

'tsho mdzad sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// gnyis pa dharma swa mi'i mtshan// slob brgyud bcas la phyag byas te// ril nag 'bring po'i sbyor ba bshad// chen mo'i sbyor ba'i nang bshad ltar// dngul 1 chu dul ma zho gsum dang*// kandha 2 ka mu zi ni zho gsum ste// 3hru'i gser dang o 4hu dngul ta5 mba zangs dang*// lo 6ha lcags a bha 7 har nag lhang tsher rnams// bzhu btul byas pa zho re re// ga8 yu dang spos she9 la byi 10ru gsum// zho re mu ti11ga mu me12na gnyis// zho phyed dug 'byin byas pa'o// gzi mdangs med rgya13la khyor ba gang*// 14gla rtsi bong nga da15kar da16mar dang*| |sa17ུga smel rnams ni zho re re// ga18ི waṃ dom mkhri19sa zho phyed re// 20cu gu21ra la22ི dang23 dzā su24ga 25ka /zho re ko byi26la rdog po bdun// nyu27nga son yung 'a28bru khyim bya yi// sgong skogs phyed re bya bar bshad// rma bya'i mdong29sa gzhob zho phyed do// a30 ru gser mdog bco lnga dang*// dpa' bo se31ra po thun bzang gnyis// mchi32na pa zho gang tshad ldan te// de ltar sman sna so gnyis so// se 'bru'i chu yis 'dam btags bya| |ril bu sran ma skam po tsam// rab gnas chen mo lta bu'o// 'di ni ril nag 'bring po ste// nad rnams kun la slebs pas chog /phan yon bsten thabs dam tshig rnams// ril nag chen mo lta bu'o// da ni 'byor pas dben pa yi// dbul po nor med rnams kyis ni// ril nag che 'bring mi spobs phyir// ril nag chung ngu'i sbyor ba bshad// btso bkru tshul bzhin byas pa yi// dngul chu 'big1 sa byed rgyal po chen po dang*// blon po gse 2 ra dngu3 la zang4sa lca 5 gas lha 6 nga tsher lnga po gang 'thad re// kandha7 ka mu zi ni dmag dpon te// bzang13 drug 'bangs la rma14 bya'i mdongs nor// gzi pad nag mdangs med15 pa'i dmag dpung gis// ka16stu ri gla rtsi yi mtshon cha bzung*// a ru gser 17mdog rnam rgyal phub tu khur// yungs kar 'a18bru yi rta la zhon// se 'bru khu bas 'dam btags bya// ril bu sran skam tshad ltar dril// bsten thabs dam tshig sngar dang 'dra// de ltar sman sna bco brgyad po// ril nag chung ngu'i sbyor ba ste| |nad rnams kun la thengs pas chog

/phan yon che 'bring lta bu ste// de ltar ril nag 'bring po dang*// chung ngu'i sbyor ba'i gdams pa 'di// dharma swa mi las brgyud pa'i// bka' lung chu bo ma nyams pa// gang gi drin kong sman dkon mchog rgyal mtshan las legs byung ba// shākya'i dge slong ming 'dzin pa// dharma kīrti zhes bya bas// phyi rabs don du bkod pa 'di// dge bas 'gro kun nad bral nas// bai ḍūrya 'od sangs rgyas kyi// go 'phang mchog de 'grub gyur cig /zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zab khyad do// //maṅga laṃ//
